_about: F9 composite knowledge graph: validated arms + FIRST-CLASS negatives/dead-ends + transfer conditions + abstention boundaries, with per-edge provenance. Integration/provenance only — makes NO new scientific claim. Built from LEDGER.md, COMPUTATIONAL_DEAD_ENDS.md, composite_router, MR1, INTEGRITY_SWEEP.md by build_kg.py (deterministic).

applies_to.metric: no metabolism -> route to structural arm

arms.name: FBA metabolic gene-essentiality target-ID
arms.transfer_condition: requires a self-contained metabolic network (GEM); enrichment not a target list (recall ~0.22)

arms.name: Conservation-breadth workhorse
arms.transfer_condition: the only transferable label-free signal is conservation; no residual for a new CPU signal

arms.name: Host-non-homology safety hard-filter
arms.transfer_condition: applies to any organism with a sequenced proteome vs the human proteome

arms.name: Structural target-class ID (viruses)
arms.transfer_condition: identifies druggable target class from structure; NOT novel-target affinity (D2)

arms.headline_metric: target's own dependency rho +0.187 (MDM2 +0.47); NO transferable functional-state beyond target
arms.name: Cancer dependency target-ID
arms.transfer_condition: signal is a drug's OWN target dependency (target-specific), not a general functional predictor

arms.name: Genetic-support (Open Targets) target-ID
arms.transfer_condition: requires GWAS/genetic evidence for the disease; confounded by gene 'fame' (adjust)

arms.headline_metric: MR-sig genes -> clinical precedence OR 3.16 (CI [2.03,5.19]); direction-aware
arms.name: Transparent cis-MR causal target-ID
arms.transfer_condition: requires a cis-eQTL instrument + disease GWAS; predictively REDUNDANT with OT aggregate (H2)

arms.name: Monogenic-disease mechanism arm (MENDEL1)
arms.transfer_condition: requires a known causal gene + mode-of-action

arms.name: SynergyRanker (drug-combination synergy)
arms.transfer_condition: new pairings of a KNOWN drug library only; NOVEL-drug synergy does NOT generalize

arms.name: Target->drug repurposing (INTERVENE1)
arms.transfer_condition: maps KNOWN targets to KNOWN drugs; does NOT expand novel-pathogen coverage (D6)

arms.name: Expression->response cross-dataset transfer (V1/V9)
arms.transfer_condition: weak, drug-specific, single-cohort; bounded by the +0.212 baseline ceiling

deadends.name: Label-free non-metabolic mechanism signal
deadends.negative_outcome: conservation AUROC 0.9078 unbeaten (NONMET1 +0.021, PLMESS1 +0.008/study-ctrl -0.0006, REGNET1 -0.006, PLMSTRUCT1 +0.0076, MULTISIG1 +0.019, MET4 +0.128->-0.004 after study-bias control)
deadends.reopen_trigger: curated mechanism LABELS or a fundamentally new data modality appears

deadends.name: Novel-target/novel-chemotype affinity
deadends.negative_outcome: docking AUROC 0.428 (HIT2); QSAR 0.90->0.67 novel-chemotype (HIT1); PCM adds nothing (B49); Boltz-2 training-leaked, novel-split n=5 ~0.52 (AFFINITY1)
deadends.reopen_trigger: the R2 OOD testbed shows a method beating the wall on a leakage-controlled novel-target split
deadends.tried: docking / QSAR / PCM / co-folding on public benchmarks

deadends.name: Single-agent human drug-response from baseline profiles
deadends.negative_outcome: cross-dataset ceiling rho +0.212; within-cancer clinical AUROC 0.504 (p=0.43); inferred functional layer fails external replication (B20/B21)
deadends.reopen_trigger: MEASURED functional/perturbation response data becomes available (experimental, outside compute scope)

deadends.name: More disease-class breadth / router coverage arms
deadends.negative_outcome: CPU-arm expansion ~= 0 marginal real-world value (independent audit)
deadends.reopen_trigger: a genuinely new signal type (not the same hypothesis in new clothes)

deadends.name: De-novo molecule generation without a validated novel-target scorer
deadends.negative_outcome: generator below SOTA (B52); no validated novel-target scoring function to optimize (D2); prior 'de novo' were relabeled scaffold-hops (INTEGRITY_SWEEP)
deadends.reopen_trigger: D2's gate opens

deadends.name: Structural repurposing for novel-pathogen coverage expansion
deadends.negative_outcome: promiscuity/fold-census artifact: 18/32 vs random null 25/32; honest novel-target coverage stays 1/32 (STRUCTREPURPOSE1)
deadends.reopen_trigger: a null-guarded method exceeds the random-fold census

deadends.name: ipTM / interface-confidence as an affinity proxy
deadends.negative_outcome: ipTM saturates ~0.95 for actives AND inactives (AFFINITY_IPTM1)
deadends.reopen_trigger: a confidence signal separates actives from inactives on a leakage-free split

deadends.name: Re-running program-level audits
deadends.negative_outcome: verdict stable across audits; the missing input is DATA, not compute
deadends.reopen_trigger: new experimental data changes the evidence base

deadends.name: Durability via masked-PLM entropy at resistance sites
deadends.negative_outcome: FALSIFIED at scale: Wilcoxon p=0.99997 (opposite direction), mean dH=-0.22, position AUROC 0.446 (below chance); overturns DYNAMICS1's n=15 AUROC 0.84 small-n artifact
deadends.reopen_trigger: a different powered observable (FEP/MD ddG or measured DMS fitness)

deadends.name: Mechanistic-coherence of cell-line->patient transfer (B3e)
deadends.negative_outcome: WITHDRAWN pre-registered null: MWU p=0.29, perm p=0.50; transfer strength doesn't track predictability
deadends.reopen_trigger: a powered multi-cohort test

deadends.name: cis-MR adds predictive value beyond Open Targets aggregate
deadends.negative_outcome: honest-negative: small significant coef (0.022) but dAUPRC +0.0001 (CI [-0.0018,0.0010]); redundant with OT
deadends.reopen_trigger: a colocalization-aware MR or a target class OT under-covers

deadends.name: Drug-synergy generalization to NOVEL drugs
deadends.negative_outcome: collapses: B24 leave-drug-out rho 0.25 -> 0.025 (CI [0.012,0.038]); the 0.25 was O'Neil chemical redundancy
deadends.reopen_trigger: a synergy model generalizes out-of-chemistry on a diverse corpus

deadends.name: Mechanism-anchored (target-dependency) synergy for novel drugs
deadends.negative_outcome: does NOT beat fingerprints for novel drugs (MECH 0.076 vs FP 0.162)
deadends.reopen_trigger: a mechanism encoding beats chemistry on novel drugs

deadends.name: External replication of inferred-FLT3-dependency layer (V19/V20)
deadends.negative_outcome: fails: pooled rho +0.05 (p=0.08), adds beta -0.02 (p=0.92), sorafenib flips sign; V19/V20 DOWNGRADED
deadends.reopen_trigger: replication in a 2nd independent patient cohort

deadends.name: Structural repurposing coverage jump 1/32->18/32
deadends.negative_outcome: promiscuity artifact; random-protein null 25/32 > drug targets; honest 1/32
deadends.reopen_trigger: see D6

deadends.name: Salvage-bypass topology explains Plasmodium FBA failure
deadends.negative_outcome: mechanism FALSIFIED: salvage-FN iPfal19 0.907 ~= Toxo 0.867; GEM swap doesn't close the gap
deadends.reopen_trigger: a mechanistic account that predicts which parasites FBA transfers to

deadends.name: Zero-data whole-protein resistance-liability
deadends.negative_outcome: NEGATIVE: composite AUROC 0.556, MWU p=0.74 (gate>=0.70); drugged-only 0.472 (below chance)
deadends.reopen_trigger: a dynamic/measured resistance observable

deadends.name: Human CLINICAL drug-response (TCGA)
deadends.negative_outcome: within-cancer AUROC 0.504 (p=0.43); raw 0.539 was a cancer-type confound
deadends.reopen_trigger: measured functional response data

deadends.name: Measured CRISPR-dependency beats baseline transcriptomics generally
deadends.negative_outcome: NO: dep 0.459 <= RNA 0.487; own-target-excluded 0.504 vs 0.514 (p=0.06) -> functional advantage is target-tautological, not a transferable functional-state signal
deadends.reopen_trigger: a functional-state predictor that generalizes beyond a drug's own target

deadends.name: Boltz-2 co-folding 'zero-shot' affinity
deadends.negative_outcome: 'zero-shot' indefensible (affinity head trained on ChEMBL/BindingDB; thrombin in-cutoff); novel-split n=5 ~0.52
deadends.reopen_trigger: a leakage-controlled novel-target evaluation (R2)
